questions.question: {If 10% of 40% of } (1)/(3) { of a number is 512, find the number.}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

10% = 1/10, 40% = 2/5

Total fraction = (1/10) × (2/5) × (1/3) = 1/75

1/75 of number = 512

Number = 512 × 75

**∴ Answer = 38400**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10% of 40% of 1/3 of a number = 512

**Formula used:**

Percentage = Fraction form

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 10% = 10/100 = 1/10

⇒ 40% = 40/100 = 2/5

⇒ Equation: (1/10) × (2/5) × (1/3) × x = 512

⇒ (1/75) × x = 512

⇒ x = 512 × 75

⇒ x = 38400

**∴ The correct answer is 38400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

10% = 1/10, 40% = 2/5

Successive Multiplication

Multiply fractions when percentages are applied sequentially

Inverse Method

Original value = Given value × reciprocal of fraction

Shortcut Tip

Simplify fractions early to reduce calculation

questions.question: {Simplify: } ((0.45)³ + (0.2)³)/((0.45)² - 0.45 times 0.2 + (0.2)²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a³ + b³) / (a² − ab + b²) = a + b

Here a = 0.45, b = 0.2

So result = 0.45 + 0.2

= 0.65 = (13)/(20) 

**∴ Answer = (13)/(20) **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((0.45)³ + (0.2)³) ÷ ((0.45)² − 0.45 × 0.2 + (0.2)²)

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identity

**Calculation:**

⇒ (a³ + b³) ÷ (a² − ab + b²) = a + b

⇒ Substitute a = 0.45, b = 0.2

⇒ Result = 0.45 + 0.2

⇒ = 0.65 = (13)/(20) 

**∴ The correct answer is (13)/(20) **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²)

Shortcut Use

Directly cancel common term using identity to avoid calculation

Decimal Handling

Treat decimals as numbers; identities still apply

Exam Tip

Always check for identities before expanding powers

questions.question: The mode and median of a data are 70.2 and 58, respectively. What is the mean of the data? (Use empirical formula.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use empirical relation: Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

70.2 = 3 × 58 − 2Mean

70.2 = 174 − 2Mean

2Mean = 103.8 ⇒ Mean = 51.9

**∴ Answer = 51.9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode = 70.2

Median = 58

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

**Calculation:**

⇒ 70.2 = 3 × 58 − 2Mean

⇒ 70.2 = 174 − 2Mean

⇒ 2Mean = 174 − 70.2 = 103.8

⇒ Mean = 103.8 ÷ 2

⇒ Mean = 51.9

**∴ The correct answer is 51.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

Rearranged Form

Mean = (3Median − Mode) ÷ 2

Use Case

Applicable for moderately skewed distributions

Shortcut Tip

Directly substitute values in rearranged formula

questions.question: {Three numbers are in the ratio } (4)/(10) : (20)/(18) : (20)/(11). { The difference between the greatest and the smallest numbers is 39. Find the largest number.}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert ratio ⇒ 4/10 : 20/18 : 20/11

Take LCM of 10, 18, 11 = 990

Ratio ⇒ 396 : 1100 : 1800

Difference = 1800 − 396 = 1404

1404 corresponds to 39 ⇒ multiply by 39/1404

**∴ Largest = 1800 × 39 ÷ 1404 = 50**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Ratio = 4/10 : 20/18 : 20/11

Difference between greatest and smallest = 39

**Formula used:**

Convert fractional ratio into whole numbers using LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio = 396 : 1100 : 1800

⇒ Difference = 1800 − 396 = 1404

⇒ Let common multiplier = k

⇒ 1404k = 39 ⇒ k = 39 ÷ 1404

⇒ Largest number = 1800k

⇒ = 1800 × 39 ÷ 1404

⇒ = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

questions.question: Simplify the expression ((49)^n times 7)/(7²ⁿ⁾ . If n is a positive integer, what is the result in terms of powers of 7 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

49 = 7²

(49)ⁿ = (7²)ⁿ = 7²ⁿ

Expression = (7²ⁿ × 7) ÷ 7²ⁿ

Cancel ⇒ = 7

**∴ Answer = 7¹**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((49)ⁿ × 7) ÷ (7²ⁿ)

**Concept Used:**

Laws of exponents

**Calculation:**

⇒ 49 = 7²

⇒ (49)ⁿ = (7²)ⁿ = 7²ⁿ

⇒ Substitute ⇒ (7²ⁿ × 7) ÷ 7²ⁿ

⇒ = 7²ⁿ⁺¹ ÷ 7²ⁿ

⇒ = 7⁽²ⁿ⁺¹ − ²ⁿ⁾

⇒ = 7¹

**∴ The correct answer is 7¹.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exponent Rule

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

Division Rule

am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

Power of Power

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

Shortcut Tip

Always convert numbers to same base first

questions.question: The cost of a washing machine is 25% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 88% and that of the TV decreases by 57%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 6 washing machines and 3 TVs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let TV = 100 ⇒ Washing Machine = 75

New WM = 75 × 1.88 = 141

New TV = 100 × 0.43 = 43

Old total = 6×75 + 3×100 = 450 + 300 = 750

New total = 6×141 + 3×43 = 846 + 129 = 975

% change = (975 − 750) ÷ 750 × 100 = 30%

**∴ Answer = 30% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Washing machine = 25% less than TV

WM increases by 88%, TV decreases by 57%

Quantity: 6 WM and 3 TV

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 ± % change)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Old total = (6 × 75) + (3 × 100) = 750

⇒ New total = (6 × 141) + (3 × 43) = 975

⇒ Increase = 975 − 750 = 225

⇒ % change = 225 ÷ 750 × 100 = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30% increase.**

questions.question: The volume (in m³ ) of a cube with edges of 41 m, is:

= 64000 + 4800 + 120 + 1

**∴ Answer = 68921 m³**

Edge of cube = 41 m

⇒ = 68921

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 3 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 6 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM(3, 6) = 6 units

Efficiency of filling pipe = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 units/min

Efficiency of emptying pipe = 6 ÷ 6 = 1 unit/min

Net efficiency = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/min

Work = 1/2 of 6 = 3 units ⇒ Time = 3 ÷ 1 = 3 minutes

**∴ Answer = 3 minutes**

questions.question: If sqrt{x} + (1)/(sqrt{x)} = 5 , find x + (1)/(x) .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

Let a = √x, b = 1/√x

(√x + 1/√x)² = x + 1/x + 2

Given = 5 ⇒ Square both sides

25 = x + 1/x + 2

x + 1/x = 25 − 2 = 23

**∴ Answer = 23**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√x + 1/√x = 5

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ (√x + 1/√x)² = x + 1/x + 2

⇒ 5² = x + 1/x + 2

⇒ 25 = x + 1/x + 2

⇒ x + 1/x = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

Key Idea

Convert root expression into standard form

Shortcut Tip

Square the expression directly to reach target form

questions.question: The Rajdhani Express and Garib Rath Express run in the same direction with speeds of 114 km/hr and 60 km/hr, respectively, and their lengths are the same. What is the length of the Rajdhani Express if it completely crosses the Garib Rath express in 144 seconds?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction ⇒ Relative speed = 114 − 60 = 54 km/h

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a cistern, individually, in 99 min and 36 min, respectively. There is a pipe located at the bottom of the cistern to empty it. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, then the empty cistern gets filled in 44 min. How long will the pipe at the bottom of the tank take to empty the completely filled cistern if no other pipe is then open?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick (LCM Method)__

Let Total Work = LCM(99, 36, 44) = 396 units

Efficiency of A = 396 ÷ 99 = 4 units/min

Efficiency of B = 396 ÷ 36 = 11 units/min

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 396 ÷ 44 = 9 units/min

Efficiency of empty pipe (C) = (4 + 11 − 9) = 6 units/min (emptying)

Time taken by empty pipe alone = 396 ÷ 6 = 66 minutes

**∴ Answer = 66 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A fills in 99 min, B fills in 36 min, all together fill in 44 min

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of time

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 4 + 11 = 15

⇒ Net efficiency (with empty pipe) = 9

⇒ Empty pipe efficiency = 15 − 9 = 6

⇒ Time = 396 ÷ 6 = 66 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 66 minutes.**

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his two sons is 72 years. If the father's age is twice the age of the elder son, and the age of the younger son is 8 years less than the age of the elder son, find the age of the father.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let elder son = x

Father = 2x, Younger = x − 8

Total = 2x + x + (x − 8) = 72

4x − 8 = 72 ⇒ 4x = 80 ⇒ x = 20

Father = 2x = 40

**∴ Answer = 40 years**
